locations.note: The game opens with a Task Force 29 raid on an abandoned, half-built luxury hotel in Dubai.
The main hub: a segregated Prague where the augmented are herded into the Golem City ghetto after the Incident.
Adam reaches Marchenko's base in the Swiss Alps and is captured and injected with Orchid.
The finale: Adam races to stop an attack on a summit in London.

routes.name: Adam Jensen
routes.note: From the Dubai raid to segregated Prague, Marchenko's base in the Alps and back to Prague, ending at the London summit.
